name: SMAA
author: automata-rtx
description: SMAA (subpixel morphological antialiasing), standalone. Detects edges from scene luma unioned with the game's own authored surface normals and depth (so geometric silhouettes and creases are caught even where luma contrast is weak), then reconstructs and blends the aliased edges. The expensive blend-weight pass uses CMAA2-style compute compaction: edge pixels in each workgroup are packed into contiguous threads so sparse edges run in fully-occupied warps. Applies before bloom/translucency so the game's post effects operate on antialiased geometry. Geometric edges need a D3D12/Vulkan/Metal device; on the compatibility renderers SMAA falls back to luma-only edges. Spatial (SMAA 1x); orthogonal patterns in this first version.
